title: Renewals Desk Note: Early Election Reduction on Residential Electricity Supply
content:
Renewals desk note, Residential Electricity Supply. A renewal elected well ahead of expiry earns an early election reduction on the renewal rate.

**Rule.** When the election is made 30 or more calendar days before the contract end date the long early-election reduction of 0.20 cents per kWh applies, when it is made 1 to 29 calendar days before the contract end date the short early-election reduction of 0.10 cents per kWh applies, and when it is made on or after the contract end date, or the agreement has no contract end date, none applies.

**Counting.** The days are the contract end date recorded on the agreement less the election date, in calendar days.

**Timeline (hypothetical contract end date 2026-06-30).**

| Election date | Calendar days before the contract end date | Early election reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-31 | 30 | 0.20 cents |
| 2026-06-01 | 29 | 0.10 cents |
| 2026-06-29 | 1 | 0.10 cents |
| 2026-06-30 | 0, the end date itself | none |
| 2026-07-10, after a rollover | none, past the end date | none |
